verdict.rationale: Auth0's MFA docs list one-time passwords and recovery codes among supported factors, and describe MFA as requiring more than one credential at login. Adaptive MFA (prompting only on risky logins) and Strong Customer Authentication for approving sensitive operations point toward conditional, step-up-style enforcement. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of TOTP authenticator-app enrollment, explicit step-up authentication enforcement per resource or action, documented tenant-wide MFA policy configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
